description.value: Body Energy Club is a Vancouver-born health food and supplement chain founded in 2002, now with multiple Lower Mainland locations and an extensive online store. The West 4th Avenue shop sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors and carries sports supplements, electrolytes, energy gels, protein bars, and vitamins alongside a full smoothie and bowl bar. Touring cyclists can resupply on ride fuel and recovery nutrition or grab a freshly made smoothie or healthy to-go meal.
